behaviors.find-tool: The Numeronym generator appears in the Text tools and opens at /numeronym-generator.
behaviors.empty-state: Before a word is entered, the result field is empty and shows an example placeholder.
behaviors.short-word: Entering a word of three letters or fewer displays the word unchanged.
behaviors.clear-word: Clearing the word restores the empty result and its placeholder.
behaviors.copy-result: The copy button copies the generated numeronym to the clipboard and briefly shows “Copied!”.

history.notes: The tool link uses its registered route, and the input locators use the data-test-id values supplied by the new component. The copy button is the sole button beside the result input; the tour checks both clipboard contents and the brief tooltip.
